name: reelhunt
description: Movie discovery app — React client + Node.js backend-for-frontend over the TMDB API

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.dev:mock: concurrently -n mock,server,client -c gray,blue,magenta "npm run mock -w server" "npm run dev:mock -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
